props.title: X Trader Monitor - BTC Technical Update

props.author: bull_genius
props.text: bitcoin in the middle of its correction move. went below ATH aVWAP on US open then a lot of shorts closed... and a dip buyer bid came in. the wick looks pretty good but also we didnt bounce as far as 7d rVWAP goes. will it be enough to paint a bullish higher low here? on paper looks like a very logical zone, however... since its still just tuesday and cpi is on friday i really doubt it. i think we can get a short squeeze to 7d rVWAP / Sept POC, if that happens i would start fading it again. i dont think september lets bulls go this lightly. in my view the correction isnt done and is still going to turn into a full scare and RSI 4H hasnt tapped truly oversold zones yet. so im waiting and enjoying longing my strong alts AI PUMP and XPL
365d rVWAP 80,277K resistance + trapped longs • 7d rVWAP 79,271K bounce target • ATH aVWAP 78,474K support • Deeper support 74,400K (30d rVWAP) → 73,600K (2024 VAH)

Aligns with Sep 07 conviction. Reiterates 365d VWAP resistance signal + bearish RSI divergence; expects full reset into mid-Sep CPI/FOMC catalysts before bull run. Hedged stance into Sep 11/16 unchanged.
